carla: quick note — i've been seeing spans lose the request id on retries when redaction is enabled in our sampleapps :thinking_face:
ben: can you share a tiny repro?
carla: minimal node snippet below:
carla: ```js
// server.js ordering
app.use(otel.init())
app.use(redactMiddleware) // currently scrubs headers for wire/logs
app.use(retryHandler)     // retry lib mutates/replays headers
```
carla: on first attempt logs show request_id=aa12, retry triggers, logs show request_id=<redacted>, and the retried span attribute becomes <redacted> too
anika: that ordering would usually cause the opposite — if redaction runs before retry the retried request would stay redacted. are you sure about the sequence?
carla: yes — different retry libs behave differently. in our node case the retry handler mutates the header object after otel captured context but before export; exporter reads header values lazily so it picks up the mutated value at export time
josh: two pragmatic options: (1) snapshot the request id into an immutable span tag the moment otel sees it (eg. span.setAttribute('rw.request_id.first', val)), or (2) confine redaction strictly to the wire/log pipeline so middleware doesn't mutate the context used by spans
ben: snapshot seems more robust cross-language, but we must make sure exporters never send raw ids. exporter-side scrubbing is required as a safety net
anika: +1 on both: snapshot at instrumentation layer and add an exporter processor that redacts any attribute in a sensitive whitelist at export time
carla: i prototyped the snapshot approach in the node sampleapp using attribute name rw.request_id.first behind a feature flag. local unit tests pass. WIP PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp/pull/8011
josh: i'll add an exporter processor (feature-flagged off in prod) that strips or hashes any attribute matching the sensitive keys list. will include unit tests that parse OTLP payloads to assert no raw ids
ben: docs item: add a short "hook-order pitfalls" note in devex/telemetry with a small matrix per SDK and a recommended pattern: otel init -> snapshot span attrs -> retry libs -> wire redaction
telemetry-bot: New issue opened: DEVEX-5320 "snapshot span attr to preserve request id across retries" https://issuetracker.internal/DEVEX-5320
carla: assigning: josh -> exporter scrubber + tests; ben -> devex doc update; me -> follow-up on PR and e2e harness. thanks all :thumbsup:
